raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
SGLang’s pinned FlashMLA source already contains MegaAttention, but the sgl-kernel build omits its fused kernels and exposes no callable APIs. Compile the fused prefill/decode kernels and weight permutations on SM100/SM103 and expose them through typed torch operators and a wheel-level Python module. Preserve the current dependency pin, legacy KV formats, SM90 support, and serving behavior.

This is the build/API prerequisite for a separate DeepSeek-V4.1 MegaAttention + NVFP4 serving integration.

Validation:
- CMake source-list checks for CUDA 12.8, 12.9, and 13.0 against the actual pinned FlashMLA source (22/64/64 paths verified; fused kernels only enabled for SM100 builds).
- Python syntax, lint, and formatting checks.
- Added SM100/SM103 numerical prefill, decode/prefill parity, and weight/scale permutation tests, plus a cold-L2 benchmark.
- [CUDA 13.0 ARM64 wheel build passed](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38309395476/job/115011351258) on head `31c0f0c7ba2da34ab36b4d95c51a5711b1b61105`: all 16 fused instantiations and the C++ wrapper compiled, `flashmla_ops.abi3.so` linked, and the wheel was produced. The x86-64 build and GPU numerical tests are still pending.

+import torch
+from sgl_kernel.flash_mla_mega import flash_mla_mega_prefill
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.benchmark import marker
+
+
+@marker.parametrize("tokens", [1, 32, 128, 512], [128])
+@marker.parametrize("heads", [64, 128], [64])
+@marker.benchmark("provider", ["flashmla_mega"])
+def benchmark(tokens: int, heads: int, provider: str):
+    q = torch.randn(tokens, heads, 512, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    kv = torch.randn(4096, 1, 512, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    indices = torch.randint(4096, (tokens, 1, 640), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    positions = torch.zeros(tokens, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    table = torch.cat((torch.ones(1, 32), torch.zeros(1, 32)), dim=-1).cuda()
+    return marker.do_bench(
+        flash_mla_mega_prefill,
+        input_args=(q, kv, indices, positions, table, 512**-0.5),
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    benchmark.run()

+#include <torch/all.h>
+#include <torch/library.h>
+
+#include "api/fused_norm_rope_attn_rope_cast_fwd.cpp"
+
+static std::vector<at::Tensor> sgl_flash_mla_mega_prefill(
+    const at::Tensor& q,
+    const at::Tensor& kv,
+    const at::Tensor& indices,
+    const at::Tensor& positions,
+    const at::Tensor& cos_sin_cache,
+    double sm_scale,
+    int64_t n_wv_group,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& attn_sink,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& topk_length) {
+  TORCH_CHECK(n_wv_group > 0 && q.size(1) == n_wv_group * 8, "MegaAttention requires eight heads per WO-A group");
+  return fused_norm_rope_attn_rope_cast_fwd(
+      q,
+      kv,
+      indices,
+      static_cast<float>(sm_scale),
+      512,
+      attn_sink,
+      topk_length,
+      false,
+      0.0f,
+      positions,
+      false,
+      64,
+      cos_sin_cache,
+      static_cast<uint32_t>(n_wv_group),
+      32,
+      true,
+      true,
+      true);
+}
+
+static std::vector<at::Tensor> sgl_flash_mla_mega_decode(
+    const at::Tensor& q,
+    const at::Tensor& kv,
+    const at::Tensor& indices,
+    const at::Tensor& positions,
+    const at::Tensor& cos_sin_cache,
+    double sm_scale,
+    int64_t n_wv_group,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& attn_sink,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& topk_length,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_kv,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_indices,
+    const std::optional<at::Tensor>& extra_topk_length) {
+  TORCH_CHECK(n_wv_group > 0 && q.size(1) == n_wv_group * 8, "MegaAttention requires eight heads per WO-A group");
+  return fused_norm_rope_attn_rope_cast_decode(
+      q,
+      kv,
+      indices,
+      static_cast<float>(sm_scale),
+      512,
+      attn_sink,
+      topk_length,
+      extra_kv,
+      extra_indices,
+      extra_topk_length,
+      false,
+      0.0f,
+      positions,
+      false,
+      64,
+      cos_sin_cache,
+      static_cast<uint32_t>(n_wv_group),
+      32,
+      true,
+      true,
+      true);
+}
+
+static std::vector<at::Tensor>
+sgl_flash_mla_mega_permute_q(const at::Tensor& weight, const at::Tensor& scale, int64_t heads) {
+  TORCH_CHECK(heads == 64 || heads == 128, "MegaAttention requires 64 or 128 query heads");
+  return permute_q_b_proj(weight, scale, static_cast<int>(heads), 512);
+}
+
+static std::vector<at::Tensor> sgl_flash_mla_mega_permute_wo(const at::Tensor& weight, const at::Tensor& scale) {
+  return permute_wv_proj(weight, scale, 8, 512);
+}
+
+TORCH_LIBRARY_FRAGMENT(sgl_kernel, m) {
+  m.def(
+      "flash_mla_mega_prefill(Tensor q, Tensor kv, Tensor indices, Tensor positions, Tensor cos_sin_cache, "
+      "float sm_scale, int n_wv_group, Tensor? attn_sink=None, Tensor? topk_length=None) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("flash_mla_mega_prefill", torch::kCUDA, &sgl_flash_mla_mega_prefill);
+  m.def(
+      "flash_mla_mega_decode(Tensor q, Tensor kv, Tensor indices, Tensor positions, Tensor cos_sin_cache, "
+      "float sm_scale, int n_wv_group, Tensor? attn_sink=None, Tensor? topk_length=None, "
+      "Tensor? extra_kv=None, Tensor? extra_indices=None, Tensor? extra_topk_length=None) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("flash_mla_mega_decode", torch::kCUDA, &sgl_flash_mla_mega_decode);
+  m.def("flash_mla_mega_permute_q(Tensor weight, Tensor scale, int heads) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("flash_mla_mega_permute_q", torch::kCUDA, &sgl_flash_mla_mega_permute_q);
+  m.def("flash_mla_mega_permute_wo(Tensor weight, Tensor scale) -> Tensor[]");
+  m.impl("flash_mla_mega_permute_wo", torch::kCUDA, &sgl_flash_mla_mega_permute_wo);
+}

+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+from sgl_kernel.flash_mla import _flashmla_import_error
+
+
+def is_flash_mla_mega_available() -> bool:
+    return _flashmla_import_error is None and hasattr(
+        torch.ops.sgl_kernel, "flash_mla_mega_decode"
+    )
+
+
+def _require_mega() -> None:
+    if not is_flash_mla_mega_available():
+        raise ImportError(
+            "FlashMLA MegaAttention requires sgl-kernel built with CUDA >= 12.9"
+        )
+
+
+def flash_mla_mega_prefill(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    indices: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    softmax_scale: float,
+    *,
+    attn_sink: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    topk_length: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    _require_mega()
+    return tuple(
+        torch.ops.sgl_kernel.flash_mla_mega_prefill.default(
+            q,
+            kv,
+            indices,
+            positions,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            softmax_scale,
+            q.shape[1] // 8,
+            attn_sink,
+            topk_length,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def flash_mla_mega_decode(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    indices: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    softmax_scale: float,
+    *,
+    attn_sink: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    topk_length: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    extra_kv: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    extra_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    extra_topk_length: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    _require_mega()
+    return tuple(
+        torch.ops.sgl_kernel.flash_mla_mega_decode.default(
+            q,
+            kv,
+            indices,
+            positions,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            softmax_scale,
+            q.shape[1] // 8,
+            attn_sink,
+            topk_length,
+            extra_kv,
+            extra_indices,
+            extra_topk_length,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def permute_mega_q_weight(
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: torch.Tensor,
+    num_heads: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    _require_mega()
+    return tuple(
+        torch.ops.sgl_kernel.flash_mla_mega_permute_q.default(weight, scale, num_heads)
+    )
+
+
+def permute_mega_wo_weight(
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    scale: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    _require_mega()
+    return tuple(torch.ops.sgl_kernel.flash_mla_mega_permute_wo.default(weight, scale))

@@ -0,0 +1,184 @@
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from sgl_kernel.flash_mla_mega import (
+    flash_mla_mega_decode,
+    flash_mla_mega_prefill,
+    is_flash_mla_mega_available,
+    permute_mega_q_weight,
+    permute_mega_wo_weight,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] != 10,
+    reason="FlashMLA MegaAttention requires SM100/SM103",
+)
+
+
+def _pack_q(q):
+    tokens, heads, dim = q.shape
+    return q.view(tokens, heads, dim // 16, 16).transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view_as(q)
+
+
+def _unpack_output(data, scale):
+    tokens, groups, hidden = data.shape
+    sf = scale.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).float()
+    values = data.float().view(tokens, groups, hidden // 32, 32)
+    values = values * torch.exp2(sf - 127).unsqueeze(-1)
+    return (
+        values.view(tokens, groups, 16, 8, 32)
+        .transpose(2, 3)
+        .reshape(tokens, groups * 8, 512)
+    )
+
+
+def _rope(x, positions, table, inverse=False):
+    out = x.float().clone()
+    cos, sin = table[positions.long()].chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    cos, sin = cos[:, None], sin[:, None]
+    if inverse:
+        sin = -sin
+    even, odd = out[..., -64::2].clone(), out[..., -63::2].clone()
+    out[..., -64::2] = even * cos - odd * sin
+    out[..., -63::2] = even * sin + odd * cos
+    return out
+
+
+def _reference(q, kv, indices, lens, positions, table, sink):
+    q = _rope(q, positions, table).bfloat16().float()
+    selected = kv[indices.clamp_min(0), 0].float()
+    logits = torch.einsum("thd,tkd->thk", q, selected) / 512**0.5
+    valid = (indices >= 0) & (
+        torch.arange(indices.shape[-1], device=q.device)[None] < lens[:, None]
+    )
+    logits.masked_fill_(~valid[:, None], -torch.inf)
+    logits = torch.cat((logits, sink[None, :, None].expand(q.shape[0], -1, -1)), dim=-1)
+    probabilities = logits.softmax(-1)[..., :-1]
+    out = torch.einsum("thk,tkd->thd", probabilities, selected)
+    return _rope(out, positions, table, inverse=True)
+
+
+def _inputs(heads):
+    torch.manual_seed(123)
+    device = "cuda"
+    q = torch.randn(3, heads, 512, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    kv = torch.randn(128, 1, 512, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    indices = torch.arange(128, device=device, dtype=torch.int32).repeat(3, 1)
+    indices[1, 48:64] = -1
+    lens = torch.tensor([128, 96, 64], device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    positions = torch.tensor([0, 17, 255], device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    angles = (
+        torch.arange(256, device=device)[:, None]
+        / torch.arange(1, 33, device=device)[None]
+    )
+    table = torch.cat((angles.cos(), angles.sin()), dim=-1).float()
+    sink = torch.randn(heads, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    return q, kv, indices, lens, positions, table, sink
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads", [64, 128])
+def test_mega_prefill_matches_unfused_reference(heads):
+    assert is_flash_mla_mega_available(), "The SM100 wheel must expose MegaAttention"
+    q, kv, indices, lens, positions, table, sink = _inputs(heads)
+    data, scale, _, _ = flash_mla_mega_prefill(
+        _pack_q(q),
+        kv,
+        indices[:, None],
+        positions,
+        table,
+        512**-0.5,
+        attn_sink=sink,
+        topk_length=lens,
+    )
+    expected = _reference(q, kv, indices, lens, positions, table, sink)
+    actual = _unpack_output(data, scale)
+    relative_rmse = (
+        actual - expected
+    ).square().mean().sqrt() / expected.square().mean().sqrt()
+    assert relative_rmse < 0.04
+    assert scale.dtype == torch.int32 and scale.stride(0) == 1
+    assert scale.stride(-1) % 4 == 0
+
+
+def test_mega_decode_matches_gathered_prefill():
+    q, kv, indices, lens, positions, table, sink = _inputs(64)
+    groups = kv.float().view(128, 16, 32)
+    sf = torch.exp2(torch.ceil(torch.log2(groups.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-4) / 448)))
+    codes = (groups / sf[..., None]).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    dequant = (codes.float() * sf[..., None]).view_as(kv).bfloat16()
+    raw = torch.empty(128 * 528, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    raw[: 128 * 512] = codes.view(torch.uint8).reshape(-1)
+    raw[128 * 512 :] = (sf.log2() + 127).to(torch.uint8).reshape(-1)
+    cache = raw.view(1, 128, 1, 528)
+    packed_q = _pack_q(q)
+    decoded = flash_mla_mega_decode(
+        packed_q,
+        cache,
+        indices,
+        positions,
+        table,
+        512**-0.5,
+        attn_sink=sink,
+        topk_length=lens,
+    )
+    prefilled = flash_mla_mega_prefill(
+        packed_q,
+        dequant,
+        indices[:, None],
+        positions,
+        table,
+        512**-0.5,
+        attn_sink=sink,
+        topk_length=lens,
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        _unpack_output(*decoded[:2]),
+        _unpack_output(*prefilled[:2]),
+        rtol=0.05,
+        atol=0.01,
+    )
+
+
+def test_mega_weight_permutations_preserve_scale_association():
+    heads, rows, width = 64, 64, 128
+    q_weight = (
+        torch.randint(0, 112, (heads * 512 * width,), device="cuda")
+        .to(torch.uint8)
+        .view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        .view(heads * 512, width)
+    )
+    q_scale = torch.arange(heads * 512, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)[:, None]
+    pq, ps = permute_mega_q_weight(q_weight, q_scale, heads)
+    q_perm = (
+        torch.arange(heads * 512, device="cuda")
+        .view(heads, 32, 16)
+        .transpose(0, 1)
+        .reshape(-1)
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(pq.view(torch.uint8), q_weight.view(torch.uint8)[q_perm])
+    torch.testing.assert_close(ps, q_scale[q_perm])
+
+    wo = (
+        torch.randint(0, 112, (rows * 4096,), device="cuda")
+        .to(torch.uint8)
+        .view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        .view(1, rows, 4096)
+    )
+    sf_bytes = (
+        torch.arange(128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)[None, None]
+        .expand(1, rows, -1)
+        .contiguous()
+    )
+    sf = sf_bytes.view(torch.int32).transpose(1, 2).contiguous().transpose(1, 2)
+    pw, pws = permute_mega_wo_weight(wo, sf)
+    wo_perm = (
+        torch.arange(4096, device="cuda").view(8, 16, 32).transpose(0, 1).reshape(-1)
+    )
+    torch.testing.assert_close(pw.view(torch.uint8), wo.view(torch.uint8)[..., wo_perm])
+    expected_sf = sf_bytes[..., wo_perm[::32] // 32]
+    torch.testing.assert_close(pws.contiguous().view(torch.uint8), expected_sf)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__]))
